rows.note: Zooms the painting inside its frame. 1 fills the frame as shipped; larger crops in. Applies to every scene that does not keep its own staging.

rows.note: Applies to every scene that does not keep its own staging.

choiceLabels.auto: Follow the transition (slow push zooms in)

rows.label: Camera movement
rows.note: The drift while a scene holds. Follow the transition keeps the original rule: a slow push zooms in, everything else is still. Applies to every scene that does not keep its own staging.

rows.label: Camera distance (%)
rows.note: How far the camera travels across the whole scene. 3.5 is the shipped push. Applies to every scene that does not keep its own staging.

rows.label: Colour wash strength

rows.label: Mirror the artwork

rows.label: Vignette strength

developer.label: Interface
developer.tip: Map and HUD, card appearance, and confirmation controls.

rows.label: Walked nodes
rows.note: How much the nodes you have already visited fade on the act map, so the way forward stands out from the trail behind you. Half mutes them to half saturation; Off keeps the trail as bright as the choice.

rows.label: Two-axis map dragging
rows.note: Drag the act map left and right as well as up and down. Off keeps the map centred horizontally and allows vertical dragging only.

rows.label: Map header
rows.note: Comfortable shows your name and full stats; Compact tightens the bar.

rows.label: Relics in map header
rows.note: Show your relic icons in the map header bar.

rows.label: Card motif
rows.note: Colour cards by their class. Wash tints the card body; Accent puts your accent on the border and moves rarity to a corner pip; Band adds a class stripe. Off keeps every card the same frame.

rows.label: Motif strength
rows.note: How strongly the class colour tints a card.

rows.label: Ambient effects
rows.note: Drifting embers and the title-screen glow. Off is the calmest.

rows.label: Control hints
rows.note: Show the bar of keyboard shortcuts along the bottom of the map and combat.

rows.label: Hold to confirm
rows.note: Choices a run can’t take back fill as you hold them, so a mis-tap can be let go before it lands. Off returns to one tap.

rows.label: Reward collection
rows.note: Auto: Continue takes everything you didn’t skip, picking a card for you. Manual: Continue means done — only what you chose comes along.

rows.label: Front column horizontal offset
rows.note: Screen pixels; positive moves inward toward the opponent, negative moves outward. Applies to both sides and their tiles; limited at battlefield edges.

rows.label: Front column vertical offset
rows.note: Screen pixels; positive moves down, negative moves up. Moves characters and their tiles together.

rows.label: Front column character layer
rows.note: Higher layers draw above lower layers. Row layer adjustments are added to this value.

rows.label: Back column horizontal offset
rows.note: Screen pixels; positive moves inward toward the opponent, negative moves outward. Applies to both sides and their tiles; limited at battlefield edges.

rows.label: Back column vertical offset
rows.note: Screen pixels; positive moves down, negative moves up. Moves characters and their tiles together.

rows.label: Back column character layer
rows.note: Higher layers draw above lower layers. Row layer adjustments are added to this value.

rows.label: Formation grid layer
rows.note: Draw the grid behind characters or above them for checking positions. The grid never blocks clicks.

rows.label: Player tile color
rows.note: Outline and highlight color for this side of the formation grid.

rows.label: Enemy tile color
rows.note: Outline and highlight color for this side of the formation grid.

rows.note: Scale the player figure without changing its combat footprint.

rows.label: Enemy sprite scale
rows.note: Scale enemy figures without changing targeting or combat rules.

rows.label: Player preferred row (A–F)
rows.note: A is the top row. A row outside the chosen grid uses its last row. Additional characters fill available columns, then earlier rows.

rows.label: Enemy preferred row (A–F)
rows.note: A is the top row. A row outside the chosen grid uses its last row. Additional characters fill available columns, then earlier rows.

rows.label: Player preferred column
rows.note: Numbered left to right across the battlefield. A column outside this team’s grid uses the nearest valid column. Front is nearer the center.

rows.label: Enemy preferred column
rows.note: Numbered left to right across the battlefield. A column outside this team’s grid uses the nearest valid column. Front is nearer the center.

rows.note: In tap mode, select a destination, then use Move. When off, tapping moves immediately. Hold mode always moves on completion or opens Move / Cancel on early release.

rows.label: Movement costs an action
rows.note: Spend one action per move. When off, movement is free.

rows.label: Tile activation
rows.note: Hold uses the shared loading delay and moves directly when complete; releasing early opens Move / Cancel. Tap uses the selection-step preference.

rows.label: Move button activation
rows.note: Hold uses the shared loading delay and moves directly when complete; releasing early opens Move / Cancel. Tap uses the selection-step preference.

rows.label: Shared selection color
rows.note: Highlight selected tiles, cards, characters and selected menu choices with this color.

developer.label: Layout
developer.tip: How windows, menus, scenes and cards are sized and laid out. Every choice starts where the game already draws it.

rows.label: Modal window width
rows.note: A window opens at the narrowest of four widths that holds what is in it. This moves every window one step along that ladder — narrower to see more of the game behind it, wider for fewer wrapped lines. Windows already open change with it, and a window at either end of the ladder stays there.

rows.label: Modal footer buttons
rows.note: How far the buttons along the bottom of a window run: Short is about a third of a wide window, Long about two thirds, and Full width gives them the whole footer — which is what a phone already does. Each window picks its own today; this asks every one of them for the same.

rows.label: Category navigation
rows.note: Every menu with categories — Shop, Armoury, Compendium, Profile, character creation — lists them down the left when they fit and folds them into one [Category ▾] button above the page when they do not. Rail and Selector answer for the screen instead, on every menu, including a narrow one that would not have chosen the list itself.

rows.label: Workspace frame
rows.note: How much of the screen a workspace menu takes — the Compendium, your Profile, the Smith and the stable. Fill the screen removes the margin around it; Inset pulls it in. Menus already open change with it.

rows.label: Scene backdrop
rows.note: The painted place behind a fight or a conversation (the drawings call it WGS6). Never drawn leaves the scene on its plain background, which is the least a scene can draw. A fight or a conversation on screen takes it at once.

rows.label: Scene ground line
rows.note: How the painting is cropped to the ground band at the bottom of a scene (the drawings call it WGS7). Aligned puts its painted ground line exactly on that band; the plain crop centres the painting instead. Where the fighters stand is set by the formation and does not move either way.

rows.label: Resting card width
rows.note: How wide a card is while you are browsing past it, in pixels. Must stay smaller than the selected width.

rows.label: Resting card width, phone
rows.note: The resting width on a narrow screen. It ships equal to the resting width above, so nothing changes until you move it.

rows.label: Selected card width
rows.note: How wide the card you have picked out becomes. Must sit between the resting and reading widths.

rows.label: Reading card width
rows.note: How wide a card is in the window you open to read it. Must stay larger than the selected width.

rows.label: Export card sizes
rows.note: Copies the tuned sizes as a JSON fragment shaped like content/config/ui/components/card.json itself — merge it in at the FILE ROOT, where it replaces sizing.levels. It carries only the widths, so ratio, bands and behavior are left alone.

rows.label: Short-screen warning
rows.note: On a screen too short for the board — a phone turned sideways, or a very short window — the game explains instead of drawing a board you cannot finish a turn on. Turn this off to draw it anyway: nothing is lost, but END TURN sits off screen on a sideways phone and there is no way to scroll to it.

rows.label: Settings panel width
rows.note: How much of the safe viewport the Settings panel may use.

rows.label: Settings panel height
rows.note: How much of the safe viewport the Settings panel may use.

rows.label: Load game configuration

rows.label: Custom music folder

rows.label: Classic appearance

rows.label: Command log

rows.label: Hover explanations
rows.note: Show explanations when the pointer rests on a detail. Keyboard and explicit inspection remain available.

rows.label: Explanation delay
rows.note: Wait before opening or switching hover and nested explanations. A tap or click selects a detail; a second one explains it.

rows.label: Explanation close delay
rows.note: Wait after leaving a detail and its explanation before closing it.

rows.label: Card flick to play
rows.note: Flick a card upward with touch, mouse, trackpad or pen to play it on the nearest valid target. Selection and the information button work as usual.

rows.label: Card flick distance
rows.note: Upward travel in screen pixels. Shorter needs less movement; longer helps avoid accidental plays. Release with an upward flick.

rows.label: Tap a card to play it
rows.note: Off (the default): a tap selects the card, and the next tap on it, or picking a target, plays it. This holds in solo and in co-op. On: one tap plays a card when there is only one possible target: a self card, an all-enemy card, or one living enemy. With several enemies a tap still selects. Holding a card selects it without playing, which shows its details and Upcast.

rows.label: High contrast
rows.note: Brighter text and stronger borders throughout for readability. On by default — turn it off for the dimmer, more atmospheric palette.

rows.label: Text size
rows.note: Scale interface text from the browser baseline. Auto follows the browser stylesheet; S/L/XL aid readability. Stacks with UI size.

rows.label: Minimum tap size
rows.note: How small a button, tab, or option is allowed to get. 44 is the size a fingertip reliably hits; smaller fits more on screen.

rows.label: Readable headings
rows.note: Use the plain UI font for titles instead of the decorative serif.

rows.label: Reduced motion
rows.note: Calm ambient effects, drop the map pulse, and shorten animations.

rows.label: Colorblind-friendly
rows.note: Shift danger/heal/blight/frost colors to a more distinguishable palette.

rows.label: Reduce flashes
rows.note: Suppress bright impact and proc flashes (photosensitivity). Damage numbers stay.

rows.label: Fullscreen
rows.note: Fill the screen when this browser supports app-controlled fullscreen.

rows.label: Accent color
rows.note: Tint the interface — highlights, borders, focus ring, and glow.

rows.label: Art quality
rows.note: Auto loads lighter art on a narrow or phone-sized screen, with Data Saver on or on a device with little memory, and the best art this game carries otherwise. Light and High pick one. Local high-res uses full-resolution art from a folder on this device, either served beside the game or one you choose, and keeps the built-in art for anything it lacks. This device only.

rows.label: Card artwork
rows.note: Simple uses the new card artwork with elemental and status accents. Legacy keeps the original illustrations.

rows.label: View mode
rows.note: Choose a layout for this device. Auto follows the window size.

rows.label: UI size
rows.note: Auto flexes the whole interface with your screen; S–XL asks for a fixed size and gets as much of it as fits.

rows.label: Quick menu
rows.note: MIRROR keeps the menu tabs and adds the destination list. SWITCHER folds the tab strip into one button on narrow screens. OFF keeps the direct-to-Settings route. Fresh or invalid values use MIRROR.

rows.label: Reset all settings
rows.note: Put every setting back to its default. Asks first, and the change can be undone for a few seconds.

rows.label: Show battlefield grid
rows.note: Show thin translucent formation lines behind combatants. This does not enable movement or placement.

rows.label: Lit city pause
rows.note: Pause with the city fully lit before fading to the menu. Reduced motion skips this pause.

rows.label: Map zoom
rows.note: Fit opens the map close enough that your current node and every node it connects to are on screen. A percentage fixes the zoom instead; + / − and ⊙ still work in the map.

rows.label: Shrine path glow
rows.note: Light the way to the nearest shrine on the act map. The lane re-aims itself as new paths open, and under fog it is drawn only as far as you can already see — it never shows you a node the fog is covering.

rows.label: HUD health and resources
rows.note: Show health, Mana and Stamina in the top HUD.

rows.label: HUD relics
rows.note: Show the equipped relic rail.

rows.label: HUD Cinders
rows.note: Show your Cinder balance in the HUD.

rows.label: HUD journey position
rows.note: Show the current act, seat and floor.

rows.label: HUD potions
rows.note: Show potion and flask shortcuts where the current layout provides them.

rows.label: Player name color
rows.note: Choose the color used for player names in the combat log. Colors with low contrast use the readable default.

rows.label: Enemy name color
rows.note: Choose the color used for enemy names in the combat log. Colors with low contrast use the readable default.

rows.label: Character sprites
rows.note: Show a drawn class figure in combat instead of your chosen sigil.

rows.label: Auto combat
rows.note: Answers your reaction prompts for you, countering the attack you can read. It never plays cards or ends your turn.

rows.label: Combat speed ×
rows.note: Scales action waits and sprite playback together. Does not change combat results.

rows.label: Auto combat speed ×
rows.note: Speed while auto combat is on, in place of Combat speed. Default ×1.5. Does not change combat results.

rows.label: Pause between steps (ms)
rows.note: The pause between each step of an action: the action, its animation, hit or miss, the target reaction, the final result, then the reset. 0 to 2000 ms (0 turns pauses off), default 500 ms, before the speed multiplier. Does not change combat results.

rows.label: Animation step duration (ms)
rows.note: Sprite animation duration at normal speed. Independent of the pause between combat steps.

rows.label: Combat pacing preset
rows.note: Mobile fast sets the pause to 250 ms and animation duration to 195 ms. Edit either value to customize.

rows.label: Combat pacing
rows.note: Auto uses Fast with Lite rendering and Normal with Full. Choose a pace to override it.

rows.label: Rendering quality
rows.note: Auto uses lighter effects on touch devices. Lite keeps targeting and hit feedback, reduces decorative effects, and uses fast combat pacing when pacing is Auto.

rows.label: Screen shake
rows.note: Camera kick on heavy hits and staggers. Off keeps combat steady.

rows.label: Show played card animation
rows.note: Show the played card flying toward its target. Off by default. Character animations, combat effects and auras still play.

rows.label: Mana ring
rows.note: Show mana as sapphire diamonds around the stamina orb. Turn off to use the top MP bar.

rows.label: Range mechanics
rows.note: Use engagement distance, Advance and Throw. Off skips these range rules. Applies to new runs; saved runs retain their rules.

rows.label: Advance SP per band
rows.note: Extra SP per band closed for the selected action. 0 removes this surcharge. Applies to new runs; saved runs retain their rules.

rows.label: Reach at Melee: Precision bonus
rows.note: Temporary Precision for a Reach action at Melee. 0 removes the bonus. Applies to new runs; saved runs retain their rules.

rows.label: Throw: Precision penalty
rows.note: Temporary Precision lost when Throw is chosen. 0 removes the penalty. Applies to new runs; saved runs retain their rules.

rows.label: Combat Armaments
rows.note: RADIAL SHORTCUTS moves flasks and potions into the combat Armaments cluster. FIXED HUD keeps them in the top HUD.

rows.label: Phone Armaments location
rows.note: Geometry only: place the radial at the lower left, lower center, or lower right on narrow screens.

rows.label: Audio
rows.note: Turn music and sound effects on. Music also has a quick toggle beside the HUD.

rows.label: Music volume
rows.note: Ambient score for the title, map, and battles.

rows.label: Sound effects
rows.note: Hits, blocks, status bursts, cards, and pickups.

rows.label: Haptics
rows.note: Vibrate on card play, damage taken and turn start, on devices that can. Separate from sound: muting audio does not stop it. Off keeps the device still.
